q: रक्षा अधिग्रहण परिषद (DAC), जिसने 2026 में ₹2.12 लाख करोड़ के रक्षा खरीद प्रस्तावों को मंजूरी दी, का पदेन अध्यक्ष कौन होता है?
e: The Union Minister of Defence is the ex-officio Chairperson of the Defence Acquisition Council (DAC) (केंद्रीय रक्षा मंत्री DAC के पदेन अध्यक्ष होते हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) DAC was established in 2001 on the recommendations of the Group of Ministers on Reforming the National Security System; (2) Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) and the three Service Chiefs are members of DAC; (3) India's Defence Acquisition Procedure (DAP 2020) prioritizes 'Buy (Indian-IDDM)'.
qe: Who serves as the ex-officio Chairperson of the Defence Acquisition Council (DAC), which cleared ₹2.12 lakh crore of defence procurement proposals in 2026?

q: प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना – शहरी 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0, जिसके तहत 2026 में 1.93 लाख आवास स्वीकृत हुए) किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय के अंतर्गत क्रियान्वित की जाती है?
o: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
e: PMAY-Urban 2.0 is implemented by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) (आवासन और शहरी कार्य मंत्रालय), whereas PMAY-Gramin is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development. Exam Boosters: (1) PMAY-U 2.0 supports EWS, LIG, and MIG urban families; (2) Smart Cities Mission and AMRUT 2.0 are also flagship schemes of MoHUA.
qe: Under which Union Ministry is the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0, which approved 1.93 lakh houses in 2026) implemented?
oe: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)

q:
2026 एशियाई खेलों की तीरंदाजी स्पर्धाओं (सितंबर–अक्टूबर 2026) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: भारत ने महिला और पुरुष टीम कंपाउंड सहित तीरंदाजी में कुल 5 स्वर्ण पदक जीते।
कथन II: कुमकुम मोहोद ने महिला व्यक्तिगत रिकर्व स्पर्धा में भारत के लिए स्वर्ण पदक जीता।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Both statements are correct regarding India's historic 5-Gold Archery campaign at the 2026 Asian Games (दोनों कथन सही हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Archery Association of India (AAI) is the national governing body for archery; (2) Recurve archery is the Olympic format, while Compound archery uses a pulley/cam system.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the 2026 Asian Games Archery events (September–October 2026):
Statement I: India won a total of 5 Gold medals in Archery, including both Women's and Men's Team Compound events.
Statement II: Kumkum Mohod won the Gold medal for India in the Women's Individual Recurve event.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: नवंबर 2026 में एशियाई विकास बैंक (ADB) ने मिज़ोरम सार्वभौमिक स्वास्थ्य देखभाल योजना (MUHCS) के लिए 21.6 मिलियन डॉलर की पहली किस्त जारी की। एशियाई विकास बैंक का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
e: The Asian Development Bank (ADB, founded 19 December 1966, 69 members) is headquartered in Mandaluyong, Metro Manila, Philippines (ADB का मुख्यालय मनीला, फिलीपींस में है). Exam Boosters: (1) India is a founding member of ADB; (2) New Development Bank (BRICS Bank) is headquartered in Shanghai; (3) AIIB (Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank) is headquartered in Beijing.
qe: In November 2026, the Asian Development Bank (ADB) released a first tranche of USD 21.6 million for the Mizoram Universal Health Care Scheme (MUHCS). Where is the headquarters of the Asian Development Bank located?

q: 2026 की निम्नलिखित राष्ट्रीय पहलों और उनसे संबंधित राज्य/धारा का कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
o: Mizoram Universal Health Care Scheme (MUHCS) — USD 21.6 million ADB tranche
Export GST refund ₹1,000 threshold removal — Amended GST Section 54(14)
e: Soreng district (Soreng Organic Fisheries Cluster, highlighted in Nov 2026 under PMMSY) is located in SIKKIM (India's first 100% organic state), NOT Rajasthan (सोरेंग ऑर्गेनिक फिशरीज क्लस्टर सिक्किम में है, राजस्थान में नहीं).
qe: Which of the following pairs of 2026 national developments and their associated states/sections is NOT correctly matched?
oe: Mizoram Universal Health Care Scheme (MUHCS) — USD 21.6 million ADB tranche
Export GST refund ₹1,000 threshold removal — Amended GST Section 54(14)

q: संशोधित GST धारा 54(14) (नवंबर 2026) के अंतर्गत न्यूनतम ₹1,000 रिफंड सीमा विशेष रूप से किस श्रेणी की आपूर्ति के लिए हटाई गई?
e: Amended Section 54(14) removed the ₹1,000 minimum refund bar specifically for exports (zero-rated supplies) so small exporters and courier/e-commerce sellers can claim refunds seamlessly (निर्यात / शून्य-दर आपूर्ति के लिए).
qe: Under amended GST Section 54(14) (November 2026), the minimum ₹1,000 refund threshold was removed specifically for which category of supplies?

q: 1947 में भारत की स्वतंत्रता के बाद उत्तर प्रदेश (तत्कालीन संयुक्त प्रांत) की प्रथम राज्यपाल कौन थीं?
e: Sarojini Naidu ('Nightingale of India') became the first Governor of UP (1947–49) and the first woman Governor of any Indian state (सरोजिनी नायडू उत्तर प्रदेश की प्रथम राज्यपाल थीं). Exam Boosters: (1) She presided over the 1925 Kanpur Session of INC; (2) United Provinces was renamed 'Uttar Pradesh' on 24 January 1950.
qe: Who was the first Governor of Uttar Pradesh (then United Provinces) after India's independence in 1947?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश को आधिकारिक रूप से कितने कृषि-जलवायु क्षेत्रों (Agro-Climatic Zones) में विभाजित किया गया है?
e: Uttar Pradesh is divided into 9 Agro-Climatic Zones (Bhabar & Tarai, Western Plain, Mid-Western Plain, South-Western Semi-Arid, Central Plain, Bundelkhand, North-Eastern Plain, Eastern Plain, Vindhyan Zone) (उत्तर प्रदेश में 9 कृषि-जलवायु क्षेत्र हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) India as a whole is divided into 15 Agro-Climatic Zones (by Planning Commission); (2) UP leads India in total production of Wheat, Sugarcane, and Potatoes.
qe: Into how many Agro-Climatic Zones (कृषि-जलवायु क्षेत्र) is Uttar Pradesh officially divided?

q:
उत्तर प्रदेश के निम्नलिखित पारंपरिक लोकगीतों को उनके संबंधित सांस्कृतिक क्षेत्रों से सुमेलित कीजिए:
1. आल्हा — (a) ब्रज
2. रसिया — (b) बुंदेलखंड
3. बिरहा — (c) पूर्वांचल
4. कजरी — (d) मिर्जापुर / वाराणसी
e: Alha (heroic ballad) — Bundelkhand; Rasiya — Braj; Birha — Purvanchal; Kajri (monsoon song) — Mirzapur/Varanasi. Correct match: 1-b, 2-a, 3-c, 4-d.
qe:
Match the following traditional folk songs of Uttar Pradesh with their respective cultural regions:
1. Alha — (a) Braj
2. Rasiya — (b) Bundelkhand
3. Birha — (c) Purvanchal
4. Kajri — (d) Mirzapur / Varanasi

q: अयोध्या (उत्तर प्रदेश) में नवनिर्मित श्री राम जन्मभूमि मंदिर भारतीय मंदिर स्थापत्य की किस शास्त्रीय शैली में निर्मित है?
e: The Ayodhya Ram Mandir is built in the traditional North Indian Nagara style (Maru-Gurjara / Sompura tradition) using pink Bansi Paharpur sandstone from Rajasthan without iron or steel (नागर शैली में निर्मित). Exam Boosters: (1) Chief Architect: Chandrakant Sompura; (2) Nagara temples feature a curvilinear Shikhara (spire) and Amalaka, whereas Dravida temples (South India) feature pyramidal Vimanas and tall Gopurams.
qe: The newly consecrated Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir in Ayodhya (Uttar Pradesh) is constructed in which classical Indian temple architecture style?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के भौतिक स्वरूप के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: The Bhabar belt runs along the northern Himalayan foothills with coarse gravel deposits.
The Vindhyan plateau region of UP covers Saharanpur and Muzaffarnagar districts.
The Bundelkhand region in southern UP forms part of the ancient Peninsular Shield.
The Tarai belt lies immediately south of Bhabar and is marshy and fertile for rice and sugarcane.
e: The Vindhyan plateau/hills in UP cover southern districts like Mirzapur, Sonbhadra, Chandauli, and southern Prayagraj — NOT Saharanpur and Muzaffarnagar (which lie in the northernmost Bhabar/Upper Ganga-Yamuna Doab) (विंध्यन क्षेत्र मिर्जापुर व सोनभद्र में है, सहारनपुर में नहीं).
qe: Which of the following statements about the physiography of Uttar Pradesh is NOT correct?
oe: The Bhabar belt runs along the northern Himalayan foothills with coarse gravel deposits.
The Vindhyan plateau region of UP covers Saharanpur and Muzaffarnagar districts.
The Bundelkhand region in southern UP forms part of the ancient Peninsular Shield.
The Tarai belt lies immediately south of Bhabar and is marshy and fertile for rice and sugarcane.

q: सम्राट अशोक के किस वृहद शिलालेख में कलिंग युद्ध (261 ई.पू.) की विभीषिका और उसके बाद 'धम्म' को अपनाने का विस्तृत वर्णन है?
e: Major Rock Edict XIII (13वाँ शिलालेख) describes the Kalinga War (8th regnal year, 261 BCE) and Ashoka's remorse leading to Dhamma-vijaya. Exam Boosters: (1) Ashoka's inscriptions are mostly in Prakrit language and Brahmi script (Kharosthi in NW India); (2) Maski and Gujarra edicts mention Ashoka's personal name ('Devanampiya Piyadassi' elsewhere).
qe: Which Major Rock Edict of Emperor Ashoka gives a vivid account of the horrors of the Kalinga War (261 BCE) and his subsequent embrace of 'Dhamma'?

q: 1793 में बंगाल, बिहार और उड़ीसा में 'स्थायी बंदोबस्त' (जमींदारी प्रथा) किसने लागू की थी?
e: Lord Cornwallis (with Sir John Shore) introduced the Permanent Settlement in 1793, recognizing zamindars as hereditary landowners with fixed revenue (लॉर्ड कॉर्नवालिस ने 1793 में स्थायी बंदोबस्त लागू किया). Exam Boosters: (1) Ryotwari System (1820, Madras/Bombay) — Thomas Munro and Alexander Read; (2) Mahalwari System (1822, North-West Provinces/UP/Punjab) — Holt Mackenzie and Robert Merttins Bird; (3) Cornwallis is also called the 'Father of Civil Services in India'.
qe: Who introduced the 'Permanent Settlement' (Zamindari System) in Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa in 1793?

q: 1575 में फतेहपुर सीकरी में 'इबादत खाना' की स्थापना और 1582 में 'दीन-ए-इलाही' का प्रवर्तन किसने किया था?
e: Mughal Emperor Akbar established the Ibadat Khana (1575) for inter-faith dialogue and introduced Din-i-Ilahi (1582, based on Sulh-i-Kul / universal peace); Birbal was the only prominent Hindu courtier to accept it (अकबर ने इबादत खाना और दीन-ए-इलाही की स्थापना की). Exam Boosters: (1) Akbar abolished Jizya tax in 1564 and Pilgrimage tax in 1563; (2) Raja Todar Mal introduced the 'Dahsala' (Zabti) land revenue system in 1580.
qe: Who founded the 'Ibadat Khana' (House of Worship) at Fatehpur Sikri in 1575 and later promulgated 'Din-i-Ilahi' (Tauhid-i-Ilahi) in 1582?

q: 9 अगस्त 1925 को लखनऊ के पास 'काकोरी ट्रेन एक्शन' को किस क्रांतिकारी संगठन ने अंजाम दिया था?
e: The Hindustan Republican Association (HRA, founded in Kanpur in 1924 by Ram Prasad Bismil, Sachindra Nath Sanyal, Jogesh Chandra Chatterjee) executed the Kakori Train Action (हिंदुस्तान रिपब्लिकन एसोसिएशन — HRA). Exam Boosters: (1) Four revolutionaries were hanged in Dec 1927: Ram Prasad Bismil (Gorakhpur), Ashfaqulla Khan (Faizabad), Roshan Singh (Naini/Prayagraj), and Rajendra Lahiri (Gonda); (2) In 1928, Bhagat Singh and Chandrashekhar Azad reorganized HRA into HSRA (Hindustan Socialist Republican Association) at Feroz Shah Kotla, Delhi.
qe: Which revolutionary organization executed the 'Kakori Train Action' on 9 August 1925 near Lucknow?

q:
होम रूल लीग आंदोलन (1916) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: बाल गंगाधर तिलक ने अप्रैल 1916 में बेलगाम में अपनी होम रूल लीग स्थापित की, जिसका क्षेत्र महाराष्ट्र (बंबई शहर को छोड़कर), कर्नाटक, मध्य प्रांत और बरार था।
कथन II: एनी बेसेंट ने सितंबर 1916 में मद्रास में अपनी अखिल भारतीय होम रूल लीग स्थापित की, जिसने शेष भारत को कवर किया।
उपर्युक्त कथनों में से कौन-सा/से सही है/हैं?
e: Both statements are correct. Tilak and Besant avoided friction by clearly demarcating their operational areas while demanding self-government (Dominion Status) within the British Empire (दोनों कथन सही हैं). Exam Boosters: (1) Annie Besant edited 'New India' and 'Commonweal'; (2) Montagu's August Declaration (20 August 1917) followed the Home Rule upsurge.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding the Home Rule League Movement (1916):
Statement I: Bal Gangadhar Tilak established his Indian Home Rule League in April 1916 at Belgaum, covering Maharashtra (excluding Bombay city), Karnataka, Central Provinces, and Berar.
Statement II: Annie Besant established her All-India Home Rule League in September 1916 in Madras, covering the rest of India.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?

q: 13 दिसंबर 1946 को संविधान सभा में ऐतिहासिक 'उद्देश्य प्रस्ताव' किसने प्रस्तुत किया था, जो बाद में भारतीय संविधान की प्रस्तावना बना?
e: Jawaharlal Nehru moved the Objectives Resolution on 13 December 1946, which was unanimously adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 22 January 1947 (जवाहरलाल नेहरू ने उद्देश्य प्रस्ताव प्रस्तुत किया).
qe: Who moved the historic 'Objectives Resolution' in the Constituent Assembly on 13 December 1946, which later became the Preamble of the Indian Constitution?

q: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 76 के अंतर्गत राष्ट्रपति द्वारा नियुक्त भारत सरकार का सर्वोच्च विधि अधिकारी कौन होता है?
e: The Attorney General of India (Article 76) is the highest law officer of the country, holds office during the pleasure of the President, and has the right to speak and participate in parliamentary proceedings without voting (Article 88) (भारत के महान्यायवादी — अनुच्छेद 76). Exam Boosters: (1) Advocate General of a State is appointed by the Governor under Article 165; (2) First Attorney General of India: M. C. Setalvad.
qe: Who is the highest law officer of the Government of India, appointed by the President under Article 76 of the Constitution?

q: राष्ट्रीय शिक्षा नीति (NEP) 2020 के अंतर्गत जुलाई 2021 में प्रारंभ 'निपुण भारत' (NIPUN Bharat) मिशन का प्रमुख लक्ष्य क्या है?
o: Setting up one IIT in every district of India
Universal Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) for every child by the end of Grade 3
Replacing all school textbooks with foreign curricula
Providing free laptops to university PhD scholars
e: NIPUN Bharat (National Initiative for Proficiency in Reading with Understanding and Numeracy) targets universal Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) for children aged 3–9 by Grade 3 (कक्षा 3 तक मूलभूत साक्षरता और संख्यात्मकता प्राप्त करना).
qe: Under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, what is the primary mandate of the 'NIPUN Bharat' Mission launched in July 2021?
oe: Setting up one IIT in every district of India
Universal Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) for every child by the end of Grade 3
Replacing all school textbooks with foreign curricula
Providing free laptops to university PhD scholars

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 25 से 28 किस मौलिक अधिकार समूह की गारंटी देते हैं?
e: Articles 25–28 guarantee the Right to Freedom of Religion (धार्मिक स्वतंत्रता का अधिकार). Exam Boosters: (1) Art. 14–18: Right to Equality; (2) Art. 19–22: Right to Freedom; (3) Art. 23–24: Right against Exploitation; (4) Art. 29–30: Cultural & Educational Rights; (5) Art. 32: Constitutional Remedies.
qe: Articles 25 to 28 of the Indian Constitution guarantee which group of Fundamental Rights?

q: भारतीय संसद में 'धन विधेयक' बनाम 'साधारण विधेयक' के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: A Money Bill can only be introduced by a Minister in the Lok Sabha.
The President can return a Money Bill to Parliament for reconsideration under Article 111.
An Ordinary Bill can be introduced in either House by a Minister or a Private Member.
No Joint Sitting is permissible in case of disagreement on a Money Bill.
e: Under Article 111, the President CANNOT return a Money Bill for reconsideration (because it is introduced with prior Presidential recommendation); the President may either give assent or withhold assent (राष्ट्रपति धन विधेयक को पुनर्विचार के लिए वापस नहीं भेज सकते).
qe: Which of the following statements about a 'Money Bill' vs an 'Ordinary Bill' in the Indian Parliament is NOT correct?
oe: A Money Bill can only be introduced by a Minister in the Lok Sabha.
The President can return a Money Bill to Parliament for reconsideration under Article 111.
An Ordinary Bill can be introduced in either House by a Minister or a Private Member.
No Joint Sitting is permissible in case of disagreement on a Money Bill.

q: कौन-सी संकीर्ण जलसंधि भारतीय मुख्यभूमि (तमिलनाडु) को श्रीलंका से अलग करती है?
e: The Palk Strait and Gulf of Mannar separate Tamil Nadu (India) from northern Sri Lanka (पाक जलसंधि भारत व श्रीलंका को अलग करती है). Exam Boosters: (1) Malacca Strait separates Malay Peninsula and Sumatra; (2) Sunda Strait separates Java and Sumatra; (3) Strait of Hormuz connects Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman.
qe: Which narrow strait separates the Indian mainland (Tamil Nadu) from Sri Lanka?

q: भारत में बहने वाली सबसे लंबी नदी कौन-सी है (जो गंगोत्री हिमनद से भागीरथी के रूप में निकलकर देवप्रयाग में अलकनंदा से मिलती है)?
e: The Ganga (total length 2,525 km) is India's longest river and National River (declared 2008) (गंगा नदी की लंबाई 2,525 किमी है). Exam Boosters: (1) Panch Prayag (Uttarakhand): Vishnuprayag (Alaknanda+Dhauliganga), Nandaprayag (+Nandakini), Karnaprayag (+Pindar), Rudraprayag (+Mandakini), Devprayag (+Bhagirathi).
qe: Which is the longest river flowing entirely through India (originating from Gangotri glacier as Bhagirathi and meeting Alaknanda at Devprayag)?

q: दक्कन ट्रैप (महाराष्ट्र व समीपवर्ती पठारी क्षेत्र) भूगर्भीय रूप से मुख्यतः किस शैल की क्षैतिज परतों से निर्मित है जो क्रिटेशियस काल के अंत में बनी थीं?
e: The Deccan Traps were formed by massive fissure eruptions of fluid Basaltic lava ~66 million years ago, weathering into fertile Black Cotton (Regur) Soil (दक्कन ट्रैप बेसाल्टिक ज्वालामुखी लावा से निर्मित है).
qe: The Deccan Trap (covering Maharashtra and adjoining plateau regions) is geologically composed primarily of horizontal sheets of which rock formed during the late Cretaceous period?

q: जिनेवा में मुख्यालय वाले विश्व व्यापार संगठन (WTO) की स्थापना 1 जनवरी 1995 को किस पूर्व व्यापार समझौते के स्थान पर हुई थी?
e: WTO replaced the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT, 1947) following the Uruguay Round / Marrakesh Agreement (1994) (WTO ने GATT का स्थान लिया). Exam Boosters: (1) India is a founding member of both GATT (1947) and WTO (1995); (2) Bretton Woods Conference (1944) created IMF and World Bank (IBRD).
qe: The World Trade Organization (WTO), headquartered in Geneva, was formally established on 1 January 1995 replacing which earlier trade agreement?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा भारत में 'प्रत्यक्ष कर' (Direct Tax) का उदाहरण है (जहाँ कराघात और करापात एक ही व्यक्ति पर पड़ता है)?
e: Corporate Tax and Personal Income Tax are Direct Taxes (collected by CBDT), whereas GST, Customs Duty, and Excise Duty are Indirect Taxes (collected by CBIC) (निगम कर प्रत्यक्ष कर है).
qe: Which of the following is an example of a 'Direct Tax' in India (where impact and incidence fall on the same person)?

q: भारत में 22 अनिवार्य कृषि फसलों के लिए न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य (MSP) की सिफारिश कौन-सा निकाय करता है, जबकि अंतिम स्वीकृति आर्थिक मामलों की मंत्रिमंडलीय समिति (CCEA) देती है?
o: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP)
e: CACP (established 1965 as Agricultural Prices Commission, renamed CACP in 1985) recommends MSPs for 22 mandated crops plus Fair & Remunerative Price (FRP) for sugarcane (कृषि लागत और मूल्य आयोग — CACP).
qe: Which body recommends the Minimum Support Prices (MSP) for 22 mandated agricultural crops in India, while the final approval is given by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA)?
oe: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP)

q: बल (Force) का SI मात्रक और कार्य/ऊर्जा (Work/Energy) का SI मात्रक क्रमशः क्या है?
e: SI unit of Force = Newton (N = kg·m/s²); SI unit of Work/Energy = Joule (J = N·m) (बल का मात्रक न्यूटन और कार्य/ऊर्जा का मात्रक जूल है). Exam Boosters: (1) Power = Watt (J/s); (2) Pressure = Pascal (N/m²); (3) Frequency = Hertz (Hz).
qe: What is the SI unit of Force and the SI unit of Work/Energy respectively?

q: मानव हृदय के दाएँ आलिंद में स्थित कौन-सी विशेष गाँठ प्रत्येक धड़कन के लिए विद्युत आवेग उत्पन्न करती है और 'हृदय का प्राकृतिक पेसमेकर' कहलाती है?
e: The Sinoatrial (SA) Node generates spontaneous electrical impulses (~72 beats/minute in a healthy resting adult) (SA नोड को हृदय का प्राकृतिक पेसमेकर कहा जाता है). Exam Boosters: (1) Human heart has 4 chambers (2 atria + 2 ventricles); (2) Normal adult blood pressure is 120/80 mmHg (systolic/diastolic); (3) ECG (Electrocardiogram) records heart's electrical activity.
qe: Which specialized node in the upper right atrium of the human heart initiates the electrical impulse for every heartbeat and is called the 'Natural Pacemaker of the Heart'?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एप्लीकेशन सॉफ्टवेयर के बजाय सिस्टम सॉफ्टवेयर (ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम) का उदाहरण है?
e: Linux (along with Windows, macOS, Android, iOS) is an Operating System (System Software) managing hardware and software resources, whereas Excel, Photoshop, and Chrome are Application Software (लिनक्स एक ओपन-सोर्स ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम है). Exam Boosters: (1) Linux kernel was created by Linus Torvalds in 1991; (2) LAN = Local Area Network, MAN = Metropolitan Area Network, WAN = Wide Area Network.
qe: Which of the following is an example of System Software (Operating System) rather than Application Software?
